judged_text: isInvalidEmail is set true on validation failure but is never reset when the user edits the emails and retries via handleAdd, and is not cleared on dialog open — only the Cancel button clears it. After one invalid submission, the 'emails must be unique and valid' error stays rendered even after the user fixes the input and clicks Add again with valid emails (validation succeeds, mutation fires, but the stale error remains until success closes the dialog), telling the user their now-valid input is still wrong.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` (`apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx`), `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` fails, but it is never reset to `false` on subsequent successful validation in `handleAdd` (it only resets in the Cancel button handler). There’s also no reset when the dialog opens (`Dialog open={isOpenDialog} onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}`) and the success handler resets `multiEmailValue` but not `isInvalidEmail`. This means after one invalid attempt, the error UI can remain visible even after the user fixes the emails and clicks Add (mutation fires while error remains), and can persist across re-opening the dialog unless Cancel was used.
